description: Value WAG only when it substitutes explicitly modelled external natural-gas consumption
required_model_structure: Explicit carrier balances plus natural-gas import and compatible sink mapping
benefits: Most defensible public method and avoids confidential internal pricing
risks: Needs explicit sink path and energy-basis consistency
caveat: Still requires reviewed coefficients and conversion assumptions

description: Value WAG through avoided external electricity purchases via explicit on-site generation conversion
required_model_structure: Explicit boiler or CHP or Vattenfall conversion path with efficiency assumptions
benefits: Can represent useful power value if conversion path is modelled
risks: Rapidly becomes speculative without public efficiency and dispatch data
caveat: Do not use in minimal S3 without explicit conversion chain

description: Apply a non-zero penalty to flared or spilled WAG to prevent free disposal
required_model_structure: Explicit flare or spill variable per relevant carrier
benefits: Simple and important guardrail against free dumping
risks: Penalty magnitude is not robustly public
caveat: Penalty should supplement physical substitution logic not replace it

description: Track WAG balances physically without positive value and use it for debug or structure validation
benefits: Very safe for debugging and structure tests
risks: Can understate useful-energy value and still needs non-zero flare penalty
caveat: Not suitable as final economic layer

description: Assign direct value to WAG from electricity-market price without explicit conversion path
risks: Physically wrong for low-LHV gases and creates free arbitrage
caveat: Forbidden unless explicit conversion path is modelled and reviewed

description: Use assumed or confidential Tata or Vattenfall internal transfer prices
benefits: Could reflect internal accounting if known
